steps.say: I'll take Q3 sell-out from GSCM, Samsung's share from ASAP and marketing spend from NERP, then compare sell-out with the targets in your file.

args.title: Q3 sell-out against target
args.subtitle: Units, 2026-Q3. Targets from Q3 targets.xlsx.
args.note: Sell-out from GSCM; targets from the attached file.

steps.answer:
**A good quarter: sell-out rose 10.3% to 1.02 million units, 2% ahead of target.** Three of our four markets beat their target; the UAE is the one to watch.

[{chart}]

| Market | Q3 sell-out | vs Q2 | vs target | Samsung share | Q3 marketing spend |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Saudi Arabia | 452,000 [{sellout}] | +10.2% | 103% [{targets}] | 32.0%, +0.8 pts [{share}] | $4.2M [{spend}] |
| UAE | 205,000 [{sellout}] | +13.9% | 98% [{targets}] | 27.2%, −0.3 pts [{share}] | $2.6M [{spend}] |
| Egypt | 262,000 [{sellout}] | +9.2% | 105% [{targets}] | 25.7%, +1.6 pts [{share}] | $1.5M [{spend}] |
| Morocco | 101,000 [{sellout}] | +6.3% | 101% [{targets}] | 29.4%, +0.4 pts [{share}] | not posted [{spend}] |

**What stands out**
- **Saudi Arabia** added the most units, 42,000 more than in Q2, and finished 3% over target.
- **Egypt** beat its target by the widest margin and gained the most share.
- **UAE** is the one market below target, at 98%. Sell-out grew 13.9%, but Samsung's share slipped 0.3 points: the market grew faster than we did.
- **Morocco** has no Q3 marketing spend posted in NERP yet.

Targets come from your attached file, Q3 targets.xlsx, not from a company system.
